title: Ecolab
desc: Event films, campaign visuals and internal showcases for Ecolab.
lead: I handled visual design for Ecolab’s films, event screens and internal showcases, including Spark Growth and RELIGHT.
body: My work at Ecolab ranged from event screens in Egypt to an internal year-in-review showcase. I handled visual design and design direction for the selected work, adapting the brand’s blue palette, typography and motion to each format.
detail: This selection includes Spark Growth, RELIGHT and sales campaign visuals alongside internal communications. The gallery combines original project material with clearly labelled portfolio refreshes.
captions: GBS+ Year in Review — refreshed title styleframe
Light Business Meetup — refreshed visual treatment
Ecolab Water Summit — refreshed water study
contribution: Handled visual design and design direction for the work presented.
Adapted Ecolab’s visual language for event screens, campaign films and internal showcases.

story.challenge: I needed to give event films, sales communications and internal showcases their own character while keeping them recognisably Ecolab.
story.ownership: I was the sole contributor to the work presented, responsible for visual design and design direction. The work spans event screens, campaign films and internal showcases.
decisions: I used Ecolab blue and consistent typography to connect pieces with very different themes.
I used motion to structure information and give key messages emphasis across the films.
I adapted each visual treatment to its setting, from event screens to an internal year-in-review showcase.
story.result: I created a selection of films, campaign visuals and event-screen work, including Spark Growth and RELIGHT, during my time at Ecolab.

context: In-house work · Senior Marketing Visual Designer at Ecolab
